page_title: NEW 2-3 MCI | Newcastle v Manchester City 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Manchester City players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+1' 2 - 3 Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low shot that goes into the middle of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
87' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
86' Substitution. Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) on for Anthony Gordon.
85' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
85' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

84' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.

84' Rodri (Manchester City) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Martin Dubravka allowed him to make a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
82' Jeremy Doku will be replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
79' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
77' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

74' 2 - 2 Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) goes on a mazy run, perfectly slipping past the opposition's defence. He aims well and places a precise effort behind the goalkeeper! Wonderful goal! Total football.
71' A pass lands at the feet of Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
70' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
69' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) on the edge of the box.
69' It will be a substitution. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is ready to enter the pitch as Bernardo Silva walks off.
68' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
66' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
63' Rodri (Manchester City) commits a foul during an attacking move.
63' This should have been a goal! Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a killer pass into the box, but Phil Foden can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
61' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

60' Rodri (Manchester City) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester City.
60' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes it short.
59' The ball is cleared after Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

58' Phil Foden (Manchester City) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Martin Dubravka was alert and the score remained the same.
58' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
55' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
52' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Martin Dubravka to dive and make a save.
51' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
50' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
49' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Manchester City get a corner.
48' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.
48' Rodri (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Manchester City.
48' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Manchester City fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
45+6' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd), who has already been caught several times today.
45+4' Rodri (Manchester City) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
45+2' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
43' A pass by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
41' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
41' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.

40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Stefan Ortega anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
39' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

39' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
37' 2 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) keeps his cool and scores.
35' 1 - 1 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes tees up Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the top right corner. 1:1.
34' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

34' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Martin Dubravka blocks the shot with his legs. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
33' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
31' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
30' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.

29' Great first touch by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) after collecting a pass deep into the box. He smashes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a fantastic reflex save and pushes it onto the bar. Brilliant goalkeeping!
29' Phil Foden (Manchester City) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
28' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
26' 0 - 1 What a goal! Kyle Walker swings a cross into the box and Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 0:1.
25' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
19' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

19' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' The ball rebounds to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
17' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Mateo Kovacic, who fails to shoot.
16' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
15' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ederson (Manchester City) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Stefan Ortega.
3' The game is interrupted now, Ederson (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' The goal by Newcastle won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
3' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Chris Kavanagh wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
2' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
